devices.body: The devices' own latency adds to the response latency: about 20 ms for a MacBook's built-in speakers (about 8 ms for wired headphones), about 30 ms for the built-in microphone, and 100 ms or more for Bluetooth (AirPods and the like).
devices.title: Wired headphones and a wired or USB microphone are recommended
